properties.LuaScriptFile:
function handler(document)
    log_info("Starting meta data Modifications doc_reference = " .. document:getReference())

	local idolHost = "qms.idoldemos.net"
	local idolACIPort = 16000
	local timeout = 300000
	local action = "modelencode"	
    
	local section = document
    
    while section do
        
        local detectionString = document:getContent()	
        --Return if no content
        if (detectionString == "") then
            log_info("Content is Nil so rejecting the document")
            return false 
        end

        params = {
            Text = detectionString,
            Model = "SentenceTransformer"
        }
        --Send ACI action to IDOL and recieve XML response string
        local response = send_aci_action(idolHost, idolACIPort, action, params, timeout, 1, {SSLMethod="Negotiate"})

        --Parse the response string into a LuaXmlDocument
        local luaXmlDoc = parse_xml(response)

        --Register response xml namespace with the LuaXmlDocument
        luaXmlDoc:XPathRegisterNs("autn", "http://schemas.autonomy.com/aci/")

        local luaXmlNodeSet = luaXmlDoc:XPathExecute("/autnresponse/responsedata/autn:embeddings/autn:vector")
        local nodeSize = luaXmlNodeSet:size()
        log_info("nodeSize "..nodeSize)
        for i = 0,nodeSize-1,1 
        do 
            local luaXmlNode = luaXmlNodeSet:at(i)
            local vector = luaXmlNode:content()
            log_info(vector)
            local xml_attributeStartValue = luaXmlNode:attr("start")
            local startValue = xml_attributeStartValue:value()
            log_info("XML Start Attr Value "..startValue)
            local xml_attributeEndValue = luaXmlNode:attr("end")
            local endValue = xml_attributeEndValue:value()
            log_info("XML Start Attr Value "..endValue)	

            vector = vector..";source=DRECONTENT["..startValue..":"..endValue.."]"

            if ( vector ~= nil) then 
            log_info("Inside the vector is not Nil Function")
            document:addField("VECTOR", vector)
            end
        end
        
        section = section:getNextSection()
    end
           
	return true	
end
